text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I did it…… I did it, I really did it,
Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I fulfilled the first promise!
I won the Takarazuka Kinen!!

I lead Mejiro Ryan, who is striking a victory pose,
to the appropriate place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much
for today, everyoooone!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I managed to repay one bit of the debt I owe for you choosing me!
I'm gonna win Arima too. Please let me win it!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Good grief... Even her greetings revolve around muscles.
That girl..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, for the time being,
I leave the Mejiro middle distances in your capable hands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Since I couldn't win today, I wish
to place greater emphasis on being a stayer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Although, there are distances where they can
both show off their true potential.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us meet at Nakayama at year's end.
At the year-closing Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, she will naturally be an even greater star,
and I hope she will have blossomed into a wonderful lady.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san... Can we really do something about this in half a year!?

That seems even harder than becoming a star Umamusume.
Still... I'll do whatever I can.
